meta.decision_rationale: Activation of the Specula Method for a community library seeking to formalize governance around collection curation and community voice in decision-making.
tradeoffs: More formal governance may slow some decisions initially
Community involvement requires time investment from volunteers
rejected_alternatives: Maintaining informal consensus model (risk of vocal minorities overriding silent majority)
Delegation to single librarian (risk of personal bias in collection decisions)

payload.next_required_input: Proceed to Phase 1: define future scenarios for the library's role in the community

framing.research_question: How can the library protect intellectual freedom while giving the community a real voice in collection decisions?
working_rules: Contributions are collected in writing before discussion

threshold_evidence.recognized_crisis: Board minutes of 2026-03-15 name the collection conflict as a governance failure.
threshold_evidence.real_mandate: The board chair signs the engagement and decides on budget and collection policy.
threshold_evidence.willingness_to_subtract: The board lists the informal veto of senior staff on acquisitions as something it is ready to remove.
